_about: Who makes it past the first years, by country (his message of 2026-09-25: "Decisive factors that decide whether a business survives the 1st year"). `curve` is ONE cohort followed year by year, never years of different cohorts stitched together; `regions` the best and worst region on the curve's last year; `obstacles` what small employers name as a major obstacle, one survey, one year.
